name: Homelite UT15520A
blurb: Pole saw. Oregon prints one chain under UT15520A Exact Fit: 10″ bar, 3/8″ low profile, .043″ gauge, 40 drive links (R40).
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints Homelite UT15520A Exact Fit on its own pole-saw line with chain R40: 10″ bar, 40 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. R40 is the .043″ low-profile retail code. The guide does not print a file size or an engine size.

bars.note: Oregon prints R40 under Homelite pole saw UT15520A Exact Fit: 10″ bar, 40 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
